featured_reviews.name: Aditya
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a member of the gym for months. When I joined, I was shown a free area upstairs for posing and yoga, but suddenly it has become restricted to women and trainers only. Who is responsible for this change?

I joined this gym specifically because of that space — I’m quite introverted, and I prefer to exercise in a quiet environment. I also run an Instagram page with over 400k followers focused mainly on bodybuilding content, so having a private area for posing is important for me. This change was never communicated to anyone.

I absolutely respect that the space is now being used for the benefit of women, but in that case, I believe men should also have access to a similar area.

Additionally, the washrooms and sauna are in very poor condition. The sauna is in terrible shape, and the washrooms — both upstairs and downstairs — have a very strong unpleasant smell. Cleanliness does not seem to be a priority at all.

He has great knowledge about fitness and he also knows and shares nutrition diet plan accordingly. He makes every session super fun, also never fails to motivate you. He gives you best training according to your requirements. Giving him all stars from my side.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I have paid the joining fee of the Cultfit/ Fitness First Gym of BKC branch in the month of June, 2024 upon constant follow from local gym staff. I have been told that some special discount offer are going on hence I should pay the fee then and can join the gym later on as per my convenience. At the time of making the payment of joining fee I have made it clear that on account of very urgent and important office assignment which will continue till August-September, 2024 and some ongoing health issues I may join the gym regularly after August or September, 2024. I have paid the fee in the last week of June, 2024. Subsequently, in the month of July, 2024 some Mr. Christie has called me and asked me to come to the gym. He has told me that he is calling me just for assessment, then I can join the gym anytime as per my convenience. I have visited and met Mr. Christie. However, it became clear that the sessions I was told for assessment by Mr. Christie were actually conducted to convince me to opt for personal training. I cannot afford the personal training offer of Mr. Christie. After that I tried to continue the gym session and visited gym 3-4 times, however, due to aforementioned office commitments and my health issues I could not visit the gym till date.

I have paid the six months’ fee in the month of June. I have called the gym at least four or five times to request this. Each time I was told it would be done and that a senior member would confirm it with me. However, I am still waiting for a call from the gym. I humbly request you to please look in to the matter and help me in this regard. I belong to middle class family and have paid the fees from my hard-earned money.

I'm writing this review to express my concern about the steadily declining maintenance standards at this gym. Given the current condition of the facilities, I strongly feel that the monthly membership fee of ₹11,000 should be reduced to ₹10,000.

There are several persistent issues that have been left unaddressed:

Tissue papers are often missing in the washrooms.

Cleanliness is below acceptable standards, with cockroaches frequently spotted on the floor.

These issues reflect poorly on the quality of service, especially considering the premium fees being charged.

Additionally, on May 7th, I visited to renew my membership and requested if my membership could be paused for June, as I’ll be traveling. The receptionist contacted the owner but couldn't reach him. I was told I couldn’t begin workouts until a decision was made. Despite clearly stating that I was still willing to renew, I was denied access. The trainer, Sahil, and the receptionist were extremely rude and made me wait unnecessarily.

As a long-standing member, this kind of treatment was very disappointing and showed a complete lack of customer support and respect. I considered not returning, but out of habit, I did only to realize that the attitude and service were simply not worth it.

Thankfully, I’ve now joined Gymathon in Mazgaon. They offered a 1.5-month free trial without any hassle and activated my membership exactly as requested, starting at the end of June. They also provide personal lockers and a steamer facility all at the same ₹11,000.

So, in hindsight, I’m grateful for the poor experience here it led me to a far better one elsewhere.
